entity.elemental.chronicle_guide.name: Aeron, the Last Skywright
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.desc: Forged with salvaged Skyforge avionics and buoyant aerogel.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.thrust: ► Hold [Space] airborne to thrust at Elytra speed in your look direction.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.glide: ► Hold [Sneak] while falling to glide safely.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.guidance: ► Press [G] to toggle Waypoint Guidance HUD.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_intro: Why does this world look so corrupted... and who are you?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_intro: I am Aeron, the Last Skywright. What you see is the aftermath of the Shattered Resonance. The Primordial Core fractured, plunging the realms into corruption.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_guard: The Crucible of Creation? What happened to the ancient guardians?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_guardi: Six primal currents once flowed in harmony. But when the Core fractured, darkness took root. Sir Solvane fell, cursed into the Everliving Knight. Terrakon stirs as the Seismic Colossus.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_balan: Is there any way to restore balance? What can I do?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_balanc: You bear the spark of the Last Element-Smith. Take supplies from my camp stash. But to face what lies ahead, you must conquer the skies. Long ago, our caravel crashed nearby.
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_ship: A crashed caravel? Where is it buried?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_ship: Buried between the stone and dirt layers nearby. Search the wreckage, retrieve the pistons and aerogel, and bring me all 4 Blueprint Maps for the flight systems!
dialogue.elemental.player.prologue_ready: Understood. I will excavate the buried wreckage and bring you the blueprints!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.prologue_go: I have calibrated your compass to the crash site. Go, unearth the Skyforge Wreckage!
dialogue.elemental.player.reminder: Aeron, remind me of what I need to salvage.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.reminder_recipe: Excavate the buried ship: salvage 4 Pneumatic Pistons, 2 Aerogel Cores, and all 4 Blueprint Maps. You currently possess %s/4 blueprints!
dialogue.elemental.player.deliver_bluepr: Aeron! I excavated the buried spaceship and recovered all 4 Blueprint Maps!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.blueprints_rece: By the Skyforge! You retrieved them all: the Pneumatic Piston, the Aerogel Core, the Element Core, and the Jetpack schematics!
dialogue.elemental.player.ask_recipes: Can you decipher the crafting specifications?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.recipes_unlocke: Already done! I have inscribed the schematics into your crafting knowledge—every part can now be forged at any Crafting Table.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.give_jetpack: And take this prototype Elemental Jetpack! Each brave Smith who journeys with me shall wield one. Equip it in your jetpack slot, hold Space to launch with Elytra speed, and Shift to glide.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.scimitar_lore_1: Now, our true quest begins. Sir Solvane's Sunforged Scimitar awaits in the southern Desert. Its blazing edge was quenched in sacred sands.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.desert_waypoint: I have calibrated your waypoint toward the nearest Desert expanse. May the winds guide your blade, Element-Smith!
dialogue.elemental.player.desert_ready: Heading to the Desert. Thank you, Aeron!
